rows.explanation: Provide a proper NYC Greenway project in the VisionZero corridor between Douglaston Parkway and 223rd St. This landscape and streetscape improvement project will replace the current concrete "jersey dividers" along this corridor, with a beautifully designed pedestrian and bicycle recreational pathway, including an expanded curb, trees and plantings, Street lighting, benches, signage, and other amenities.
